# Better Business Bureau (BBB)

> > BBB helps consumers find trustworthy businesses, file complaints, and avoid scams while helping businesses build credibility through accreditation and trust standards.

The Better Business Bureau operates across the United States and Canada as a nonprofit organization focused on marketplace trust. BBB provides business profiles, accreditation services based on BBB Standards for Trust, consumer complaint resolution, and scam tracking to promote ethical business practices and protect consumers.

## Key Topics

- BBB Accreditation
- BBB Standards for Trust
- Business Trust & Credibility
- Consumer Protection
- Scam Reporting & Fraud Prevention
- BBB Accreditation Seal
- Business Directory & Profiles
- Complaint Resolution
- Accreditation Benefits
- Customer Confidence
- BBB Get a Quote Program
- Ethical Business Practices
- Marketplace Trust

- [BBB | Better Business Bureau](http://www.bbb.org/): BBB homepage: find accredited businesses, file complaints, report scams

## Business Accreditation

- [Get Accredited: Learn more about BBB Accreditation](https://www.bbb.org/get-accredited): BBB Accreditation program: benefits and standards for business trust
